description: Start StackGo identity verifications and retrieve their results.

api.description: Start an individual verification; it uses plan credit, and with emailUser "Yes" StackGo emails the person an invitation

fields.description: Request body sent to StackGo as-is. StackGo has not published the field list; its quickstart uses firstName, lastName, email, emailUser ("Yes" emails the person an invitation), type (e.g. "kyc"), triggeredBy ("direct") and active (true).

api.description: Download a document or selfie image captured during a verification (needs the verification.image key scope)

fields.description: ID of the verification the image belongs to
ID of the captured document or selfie image
The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set.
The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8.
Media type of the file, for example application/pdf.
Size of the file in bytes.
Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit.
